note: The original describes only the soldier (the holotype is a freshly moulted specimen) and provides a table of measurements, with no description of the alate; translated from the original description of Krishna & Emerson 1962.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text:
The soldier most resembles that of G. palauensis, from which it differs in the steeper frontal surface, the narrower head, the narrower anterolateral corners of the pronotum, and the anterior margin of the labrum not pointed in the middle. Compared with G. taveuniensis the head is larger, the frontal surface less steeply sloping, the postmentum longer, the pronotum larger with wider anterolateral corners and more rounded posterolateral margins. Compared with G. schmidti the head is shorter, the frontal surface less steeply sloping, the anterior margin of the pronotum more shallowly concave, the sides nearly parallel, and the posterolateral margins straight and meeting the posterior margin at an angle. Compared with G. lighti the head is shorter and wider, the frontal surface less steeply sloping, the pronotum wider with wider anterolateral corners, and the posterolateral margins straight or concave.

The type locality is Nissan Island, Green Islands, Papua New Guinea (4°30′S, 154°20′E); the holotype is 1 soldier, nymphs were also collected, by L. J. Dumbleton, no. 11, from rotten wood.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Freshly moulted specimen. Head yellow, paler posteriorly, the frontal region brownish; labrum yellow; mandibles pale brown, yellowish at the base; pronotum pale yellow; antennae, legs and nota nearly white with a yellow tinge. Head and pronotum with sparse erect setae, the margins and disc of the pronotum with both long and short setae. Head long and narrow, wider posteriorly; anterodorsal projection indistinct, the surface rough; the middle of the frons slightly concave; the frontal surface slopes at about 60° in profile. Eyes small, oval. Labrum reaching the end of the first marginal tooth of the left mandible, the anterior margin convex. Mandibles short, slightly raised at the outer base; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the first and second close together, the third distant and broad-based, the posterior margin of the second tooth and the anterior margin of the third forming a concave cutting edge; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the second extremely indistinct, the tip of the first marginal tooth 0.30 mm from the tip of the apical tooth. Postmentum long, the anterior margin straight, constricted at about one third from the proximal end, its maximum width slightly more than twice its minimum width. Antennae 11-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 equal in length. Pronotum as wide as the head, the anterior margin deeply and angularly concave, the anterolateral corners narrow, the sides contracting backwards, the posterior margin nearly straight. Femora slender.

Measurements of the holotype soldier: head length (to mandibular base) 1.65 mm; head width 0.98 mm; head height 0.84 mm; left mandible length 0.71 mm; postmentum maximum width 0.36 mm, minimum width 0.15 mm, length 1.20 mm; pronotum median length 0.45 mm, maximum length 0.60 mm, width 0.98 mm; hind tibia length 0.69 mm.
